game_title: Fallback: Stride Selector – Fairy Ring Glade
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade, a glade ringed by mushrooms: the forest ranger must hold off bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade: a glade ringed by mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Fairy Ring Glade, repeat each round: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones. Then check stones and advance.
player_objective: Protect the root gate from bramble beasts in Fairy Ring Glade: keep stones above zero until the 29-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Stride Selector
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 3, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
